title: KCP endeavor_promotion_prepare request (amendment A5 wire name for DESIGN.md §11.6's mission_promotion_prepare; byom §16.3 EndeavorFormationIntent/Slot)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2). Step 0 of the §16.3 formation saga: the collaboration bundle plus ONE durable formation intent and uniqueness slot, with NO external contact at all. Every byom fact the intent pins — the endpoint incarnation, the Society recovery epoch, and the KoveeRealmByomBinding quadruple — is read from the ACTIVE seam governance_enable committed, never asserted by the caller; the project, space, and branch come from the pinned frontier. UNIQUE(realm_id, requested_by_principal, client_formation_key) deduplicates one explicit human formation command — it does not imply one Endeavor per Branch, frontier, purpose, or Society. Registry (governed_work_binding_v1): surface operator / human realm-owner principal only — never a service identity, session, assistant, or connector. Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible.

society_ref.description: The already-active Society the active KoveeSocietyMapping covers (byom's society_id, verbatim). This operation never bootstraps one.

frontier_ref.description: An already pinned SpaceFrontier — the exact frontier this formation forms at.

collaboration_context_bundle_ref.description: A Kovee ContextAssembly taken AT that frontier; a bundle assembled at another frontier is refused.

bound_participant_ref.description: The already admitted human byom Participant the delegated principal acts for. R39 never manufactures membership.

client_formation_key.description: The §16.3 uniqueness scope: one explicit human formation command.

endeavor_proposal.description: The canonical EndeavorProposal subject body, carried opaque; its shape is normatively owned by byom's B0.1 endeavor_propose subject. The server recomputes the canonical Endeavor subject — this can only match it.

source_principal_position.description: The source principal's OWN explicit Position filling the sole computed formation seat. The operation cannot import an offline Position, fill another Participant's seat, or invoke an automatic assent policy.

args.description: The bundle and intent arguments. Everything byom-facing is derived, not asserted.

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
